title: Meesho seller Reel references, 2026-10-18
purpose: Format study for the @mee.ship team. Watch these, then shoot our OWN original versions. The footage belongs to other creators: never post it, re-upload it or use it in a @mee.ship edit.
clip_notes: The first 3.5s of each of the 9 source Reels, back to back (31.5s, 720x1280). The yellow R-number top left shows which source is playing.
full_sources: The full source Reels, contact sheets and a written breakdown are in the project folder (social/reel-refs/2026-10-18/). They aren't in this repo.
how_to_use: Use the 'shots' list of a matching source as a shot list: film the same kind of shot with our own phone, products and parcels.
Record our own Hinglish voice line with one real number from our own panel, and one lesson.
Keep it phone-shot, normal light, real sound. That's why these look real, not AI.

sources.format: Daily challenge vlog: 'Day 1 of 5 lakh sales in 30 days'
sources.hook: VO: 'From today we start a challenge: 5 lakh sales in 30 days' over a floor covered in parcels.
sources.voiceover_summary: Today 151 orders, ₹32,463 sales. Each day I'll share my sales plus one Meesho problem and its fix. Day 1 fix: a price calculator (enter product cost + shipping, get the listing price). Next video: how to reduce returns. Follow for day 2.

shots.shows: Text 'Welcome to Day one of 30 days challenge', camera pans the floor and shelves

shots.shows: Packing on the floor, 'Like Comment Share Follow' text, then 'Follow for day 2'

sources.format: Day-in-the-life story told in first person
sources.hook: VO: 'Whatever happens, happens for the best. Today I got 181 orders on Meesho' over a huge purple parcel pile.
sources.voiceover_summary: 181 orders, wondering how to pack them all; cousins arrive and help pack. Count and separate by courier. Pickup comes. Returns: 24 courier returns, 4 customer returns. Courier returns only lose packaging; customer returns are the real loss.

shots.shows: Close handheld pan over a big pile of packed purple Meesho parcels
Family members arrive and start packing, one smiles at the camera
shots.use_for: Human, family-business angle; makes it relatable

shots.shows: Woman packing and sorting parcels on the floor next to the pile
shots.use_for: Packing b-roll under the story VO

shots.shows: Stack of cartons by the wall, empty cartons on the floor
shots.use_for: Transition: packing done, ready for pickup

shots.shows: Man laughing (comedy cut-in)
shots.use_for: Reaction beat; we'd use Yash's own reaction clip

shots.shows: Filling and carrying a big carton of parcels
Sorting and opening returned packets on the floor
shots.use_for: Returns lesson: courier vs customer returns

sources.format: One continuous shot plus one pain point
sources.hook: VO: 'This is Meesho customer returns' as the camera dives into a heap of Shadowfax/Delhivery return packets.
sources.voiceover_summary: Customer returns eat the seller's whole profit; the seller pays a reverse delivery charge on every packet (they say ₹175 each; not verified by us). Look how many there are.

shots.shows: Single handheld shot moving over a huge pile of courier return packets
shots.use_for: The whole Reel can be ONE shot plus our VO: cheapest format to make

shots.shows: Hand gesturing over the pile
shots.use_for: Pointing beat while saying the number

shots.shows: Hand pulling and showing individual return packets, then a wide shot of the pile
shots.use_for: Show one bad return close up, then the lesson (e.g. how to cut returns)

sources.caution: Don't repeat their ₹175 figure as fact; use our own numbers.

sources.format: Printer-pour hook plus a promise of tips
sources.hook: Labels pouring out of a thermal printer with '+500 orders' text at the top. VO: 'I have 500+ orders, see how fast my labels are printing'.
sources.voiceover_summary: How to get this many orders, in 3 steps: dispatch the same day; focus on packaging; better packaging means better ratings means more customers. Follow for the next video.

shots.shows: Static shot of a thermal printer pushing out a long strip of labels that piles on the floor, '+500 orders' text at top
shots.use_for: Best visual hook of the set. Our version: our printer, our real order count, then the label crop tip

formats_to_shoot.name: Seller Diary (Day N)
formats_to_shoot.beats: Day N title over parcels, then today's real order count on screen, then one problem, then one fix (sometimes our free tool on a real screen), then 'Follow for Day N+1'.

formats_to_shoot.name: One-shot pain
formats_to_shoot.beats: One handheld shot (return pile, label mess, damaged parcel) plus our VO: one real number from our sheet, then one fix.

formats_to_shoot.name: Printer-pour hook
formats_to_shoot.beats: 2s of labels pouring with the real order count pinned at the top, then the tip (e.g. label crop + invoices).

do_not: Post or re-edit this footage; shoot our own or use a seller's clips with their written OK and a caption credit.
Use income promises ('1 crore') or course/phone-number endings.
Use borrowed songs or podcasts as the main audio.
Repeat other creators' numbers as facts.
